# SCI-MAP v0.2

Scientific contract: **v0.2**. Document revision: **r0.1**. Date:
**2026-09-07**.

Status: **scope-approved successor candidate; scientific-owner disposition,
implementation-blind consistency review, source binding, and freeze remain
pending.** This package does not assert implementation conformity, validation,
Registry activation, application availability, readiness, or production use.

## Program adherence and prior-work recovery

This candidate follows the [scientific-contract charter](../../../README.md),
the [pilot process](../../../PILOT_PROCESS_REVIEW_2026-08-16.md), the
[downstream roadmap](../../../DOWNSTREAM_CONTRACT_ROADMAP_2026-08-26.md), and
the immutable [SCI-MAP v0.1/r0.7.1 predecessor](../v0.1/SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_FREEZE_R0.7.1.md).
Its package-local [sanitized prior-work synthesis](PRIOR_WORK.md) records the
implementation-blind recovery. The complete manager recovery remains a
[locator](../../../studies/SCI_MAP_POST_FREEZE_RECONCILIATION_2026-09-07/PRIOR_WORK.md)
outside the author channel and was not opened by the author.

The candidate adopts the frozen ordinary MAP authority, the eight approved
post-freeze MAP dispositions, the already resolved one-hot and unique-original
exposure decisions, and the admitted uniform PTC coefficient family and
separate MAP permission. It cites the exact AST, PTC, VAL, NOI, boundary,
profile, and source identities enumerated in [AUTHOR_REFERENCES.json](AUTHOR_REFERENCES.json).
It supersedes only the predecessor clauses named in
[PREDECESSOR_SUCCESSOR_MAPPING.md](PREDECESSOR_SUCCESSOR_MAPPING.md). Other
coefficient families, numerical or mode defaults, additional NOI permissions,
FRUIT methods, OOF science, and application/audit/validation material remain
deferred or excluded.

No fresh scientific derivation remains or was performed. The work is faithful
incorporation, exact change control, and agreement among the common source and
three audience views. The approved author packet is the 56 content-bound files
in `AUTHOR_REFERENCES.json`, the exact approved Scope Brief, and its owner
approval. Implementation-derived material remains outside this package.

## Product and authority

SCI-MAP v0.2 defines ordinary nonpolarimetric observation mapmaking and
equal-observation coaddition. It preserves all **52** stable requirement IDs
`SCI-MAP-REQ-001` through `SCI-MAP-REQ-052` and all **25** prediction IDs
`SCI-MAP-PRED-001` through `SCI-MAP-PRED-025`.

The single canonical LaTeX authority is
[`src/SCI-MAP-v0.2_SHARED_AUTHORITY_r0.1.tex`](src/SCI-MAP-v0.2_SHARED_AUTHORITY_r0.1.tex)
followed by the six common modules in their listed order. The three rendered
views import that same source:

- `pdf/SCI-MAP-SCIENTIFIC-RATIONALE-v0.2.pdf`;
- `pdf/SCI-MAP-ENGINEERING-CONFORMANCE-v0.2.pdf`; and
- `pdf/SCI-MAP-FORMAL-SCIENTIFIC-ENGINEERING-CONTRACT-v0.2.pdf`.

The formal view is retained as a third entry point. It has no independent
scientific clauses. Stable PDF filenames identify the current v0.2 views;
revision r0.1 is explicit in titles, metadata, running headers, and source.

## Incorporated successor decisions

Revision r0.1 incorporates the approved post-freeze dispositions without
changing the inherited estimator family:

1. relative support is an operational policy with no physical optimality or
   significance meaning;
2. `coverage_cut` has its complete approved finite-nonnegative domain,
   zero/ordinary/expert/failure behavior, and four recorded state/value stages;
3. every valid product discloses its known MAP-local realized operator while
   upstream-conditioned and whole-chain response remain separately typed;
4. covariance disclosure is honest and may be incomplete or lineage-resolvable
   without invalidating the base map;
5. complete logical observation bundles precede coaddition while physical
   persistence follows the effective plan, including a conforming coadd-only
   entry;
6. Pointing and OOF may reuse the exact operator when their own contracts and
   profiles supply the required mode authority;
7. canonical grids may be requested before construction and use exact
   centered-integer embedding; a later crop is a new row-selected product; and
8. the admitted uniform PTC family is available only through explicit
   selection and the complete exact handoff, with no default or fallback.

Independent experimentation remains unrestricted. Official scientific
identity and claims follow versioned change control.

## Claim boundary

The approved scope and listed science are sufficient and contain no identified
scientific contradiction. This candidate still requires manager scope/parity
review, scientific-owner disposition of the complete successor, fresh
implementation-blind consistency review, and exact source binding before any
freeze. Application audit, repair, qualification, and production decisions are
